items.title: Inspect main.py / chat_utils integration points
items.acceptance: Identified GPT call site, frontier inputs, pose_pred format.

items.title: Create todo/todo.json
items.acceptance: todo/todo.json exists at project root with valid schema.

items.title: Build feature extractor utils/graph_builder.py
items.acceptance: build_features(...) returns dict of torch tensors: robot_feat, frontier_feat, edge_feat with documented dims.

items.title: Implement agents/gnn_assigner.py (model + inference)
items.acceptance: GNNAssigner.assign(...) returns {robot_i: frontier_j} dict identical in shape to chat_with_gpt4v output. Loads optional ckpt, falls back to nearest if no ckpt.

items.title: Add GPT trace collection (utils/gpt_trace.py + hook in main.py)
items.acceptance: Setting GNN_TRACE_DIR env var writes jsonl lines containing serialized features + GPT assignment per decision step.

items.title: Implement scripts/train_gnn_assigner.py (BC training)
items.acceptance: Loads jsonl traces from data/gnn_traces, trains with CE loss, saves ckpt to outputs/gnn/.

items.title: Wire --nav_mode gnn into arguments.py and main.py
items.acceptance: python main.py --nav_mode gnn runs without import error; uses GNNAssigner instead of GPT.

items.title: Smoke-test imports and graph builder
items.acceptance: python -c smoke test constructs random inputs, runs assigner, prints valid assignment dict.

items.title: Rewrite Report/*.tex to integrate GNN distillation content
items.acceptance: Report/main.tex updated (title/author with NetID/abstract/keywords/section names); Report/sections/{introduction,systemdesign,evaluation,conclusion}.tex rewritten focused on GNN distillation; references.bib appended with yu2023conavgpt, velickovic2018gat, hinton2015distillation, ross2011dagger; original .tex files preserved as .bak.
items.notes: Could not run pdflatex to validate build (conda texlive install missing format files; sudo blocked). Sanity-checked: every \cite key exists in references.bib; no missing \includegraphics targets; \input paths intact.

items.title: Reframe Report to original Vulcan + GNN-replaces-VLM-planner
items.acceptance: Restored original Vulcan structure (intro/systemdesign/evaluation/conclusion). main.tex abstract & title reframed to GNN-Enhanced Vulcan. introduction.tex: added Why-GNN-over-VLM paragraph in challenge #3, fig caption updated, contributions list updated. systemdesign.tex: replaced 'VLM-Based Global Planning under Fire Hazards' subsection with 'GNN-Based Global Planning under Fire Hazards' (bipartite graph, cross-attention, BC). evaluation.tex: added 'GNN Global Planner vs. VLM Teacher' subsection with two real-data tables. conclusion.tex: rewritten to reflect distilled GNN planner.
items.notes: All cite keys validated against references.bib. pdflatex still unavailable to compile.
